entries: Drawing reading and preparation | drawings and measuring tools and grinding wheels | study drawings and work orders, measure workpieces with precision measuring tools and lay out and mark to the drawing, and select cutting tools and tooling and grinding wheels and calculate indexing according to material and size and tolerance and surface requirements.

Machine setup | parameters and first articles | mount and position cutting tools and grinding wheels and tooling, set and adjust machine controls and speed and feed and cooling parameters, and make a trial cut or first-article confirmation.

Operation and tending | running and adjusting | start up and operate or tend grinding and honing and polishing machine tools, operate controls to index or adjust, observe the running state, and correct as needed.
Clamping and handling | hoisting and feeding | hoist, position, and clamp workpieces, slide shims and adjust air cylinders and thread and feed manually, and handle cooling and lubrication.

Inspection and defect handling | measurement and appearance | inspect or measure finished parts, judge dimension and appearance and surface defects, and rework or segregate and escalate according to the system.

Maintenance and records | machine tools and ledgers | repair or replace machine tool parts, brush or spray on lubricants and coolants, maintain inventory and materials, and record product and processing data.

subject.summary: This occupation corresponds to U.S. 51-4033.00, setting up, operating, or tending metal / plastic grinding-related machine tools to remove stock and burrs, sharpen edges and corners, polish, hone, and grind, and inspecting and recording to specifications. Setup and operation may be divided, and batch work is not a required condition. Projections are not actual hiring, individual outcomes, or AI causality.
